content.short: Lemon is an Argentine crypto and fiat wallet with digital dollars, a Visa card and crypto and stock trading.
content.description: Lemon, founded in 2019, is a Latin American crypto and fiat wallet used by more than four million people in Argentina and other countries to hold pesos, dollars and crypto in one app. Users hold digital peso and dollar accounts that earn daily yield, buy and sell Bitcoin and more than 10,000 stocks, convert to USDt digital dollars to protect savings from inflation, and spend with a Visa card that offers cashback and QR payments. Regulated as a virtual asset service provider in Argentina, Lemon has issued over two million cards and processed billions of dollars in volume, bridging traditional money and crypto for everyday Latin Americans.
